metadata.title: Jericó Seismic-Resilient Redesign: Costing Specification for Agente-05 Handoff

executive_summary.scope_brief: Complete redesign of existing road corridor with seismic resilience enhancements, geotechnical stabilization (piles, drainage, geotextiles), and elastic CBUQ pavement with 15% seismic cost adder.

sicro_rate_mapping.source: DNIT Standard Compositions Index (Banco de Preços)
sicro_rate_mapping.note: All rates below are in BRL per unit (m, m³, m², km) as of Dec 2024. Updates required monthly via DNIT official tables.

SICRO_GEO_001_MICRO_PILE_DRILLING.description: Micro-pile drilling and installation (inclined 45°, 150mm diameter, reinforced)

SICRO_GEO_002_DEEP_DRAINAGE.description: Deep drainage system installation (synthetic geocomposite, perforated PVC, sand filter layer)

SICRO_GEO_004_SLOPE_STABILIZATION.description: Slope stabilization (micro-piles + shotcrete + anchorages, per linear km)
SICRO_GEO_004_SLOPE_STABILIZATION.notes: Per-km rate; typical slope length 2-3 km. Includes safety netting and temporary support.

SICRO_PAV_001_EARTHWORK.description: Earthwork and terrain preparation (cutting, filling, compaction to 95% Proctor)

SICRO_PAV_002_CBUQ_ELASTIC.description: Elastic CBUQ (concrete asphalt, seismic-resilient binder, 50mm thick layer)
SICRO_PAV_002_CBUQ_ELASTIC.seismic_modifier_justification: Elastic binder and reinforcement mesh add 15% to base CBUQ cost
SICRO_PAV_002_CBUQ_ELASTIC.notes: Includes resilient binder (SBS modified, 60-70 pen), interlayer geotextile, and compaction to 97.5% Marshall.

SICRO_PAV_003_BASE_COURSE.description: Crushed stone base course (0-50mm, BGS certified, compacted to 100% Proctor)

location_multiplier.justification: Jericó is 180 km from Belo Horizonte (4-hour drive). Road access adequate but elevation and terrain complexity warrant 8% adder.

labor_multiplier.justification: Geotechnical expertise (seismic design, micro-piles) scarce in region. Estimated labor adder 12-15%.

equipment_rental_multiplier.justification: Equipment must be trucked from BH (320 km); setup and demobilization add 12%.

applied_adjustments.notes: Use 1.285x as all-in regional multiplier for cost estimation (applies to base SICRO rates).

project_seismic_profile.liquefaction_risk_category: HIGH (LI > 0.4; sandy silts with high water table)

micro_pile_system.enhancement_description: Inclined micro-piles at 45° instead of vertical; enhanced reinforcement (Grade 550 steel); higher capacity for lateral forces

elastic_cbuq_pavement.enhancement_description: SBS-modified binder (60-70 pen) vs. conventional PEN 60; interlayer geotextile mesh; rut-resistant design

drainage_system_enhancement.enhancement_description: Dual-layer drainage (internal + perimeter); sumps with check valves; earthquake-proof connections

geotextile_reinforcement.enhancement_description: Seismic-grade geotextile (higher tear strength, UV stabilizers); wider overlap (1.5m vs. 1.0m)

slope_stabilization.enhancement_description: Inclined anchor arrays (higher lateral resistance); seismic netting; dynamic load rating for micro-piles

seismic_adder_summary.note: Seismic adders range 8-15% depending on component. Overall project adder is 10.71% (within 8-12% guideline).

moderate_hazard_zone.components: Enhanced micro-piles, elastic binder, seismic drainage, wider geotextile overlap

high_hazard_zone.components: Full resilient design, dynamic analysis, anchor arrays, continuous monitoring

liquefaction_risk.if_li_exceeds_threshold: Add additional 5-10% for deepened piles, improved drainage, stabilization
liquefaction_risk.jerico_status: LI = 0.48 (EXCEEDS threshold; additional 8% applied to piles + drainage)

contingency_guidelines.contingency_reserve_policy: Cost Reserve for Unknown Items and Risks

contingency_allocation_rules.condition: Design phase (PE), detailed geotechnical investigation complete

contingency_allocation_rules.rationale: High-risk soils; unexpected stabilization may be required
Design iterations and unforeseen dynamic effects
Most unknowns resolved; contingency reduces over time

contingency_management.allocation_approval: Agente-05 (Orcamento) approves contingency use with supporting documentation
contingency_management.monthly_burn_rate_tracking: Earned value vs. planned contingency reserve
contingency_release_criteria: Design assumptions validated in field (boreholes confirm geotechnical profile)
Execution phase 75%+ complete with stable unit costs

release_schedule.reason: Material prices and supplier confirmations locked
Field conditions confirmed; execution risks reduced
Remaining unknowns minimal; final contingency available for close-out

contingency_reserve_tracking.note: Contingency fully allocated by project completion; no reserve for post-closeout.

design_phase.payment_terms: 50% advance upon PO (day 1), 50% upon completion of 100% drawings and specifications

procurement_phase.payment_terms: Monthly progress-based: 50% upon order placement, 50% upon delivery/warehouse receipt and quality inspection

execution_phase.payment_terms: Monthly progress-based: Invoices submitted for completed work measured by ASMR (Asphalt Smile Rating) and DCP (Deflection Control Program) metrics; 2% retention held until project completion

detailed_payment_schedule.description: Design completion (100% drawings, specifications, Projeto Executivo)
Site mobilization, equipment setup, baseline survey
detailed_payment_schedule.payment_trigger: Monthly progress invoice (ASMR = Asphalt Smile Rating > 3.5/5)

detailed_payment_schedule.description: Earthwork and geotechnical phase begins (slope prep, drainage)
Geotextile deployment and base course placement
Base course and subbase installation (bulk of earthwork)

detailed_payment_schedule.payment_trigger: Monthly invoice + ASMR ratings, rutting measurements

detailed_payment_schedule.description: Elastic CBUQ completion (100% width) + slope stabilization final touches
Final inspection, as-built documentation, defects rectified

detailed_payment_schedule.payment_trigger: 12 months after completion, zero defects verified

retention_schedule.retention_calculation: 2% of monthly progress payments (execution phase only)
retention_schedule.retention_release_timing: 12 months after project completion + zero defects certified
retention_schedule.retention_interest: No interest accrual; retained funds kept in escrow account

payment_procedures.invoice_submission: Contractor submits invoice by 25th of month, with supporting documentation (progress photos, test reports, signed time sheets)
payment_procedures.payment_method: Bank transfer to contractor's designated account (registered with Agente-05)
supporting_documents_required: Monthly invoice on contractor letterhead with tax ID (CNPJ)
ASMR (Asphalt Smile Rating) for pavement work; IRI (International Roughness Index)
DCP (Dynamic Cone Penetrometer) for base course compaction verification
Load test reports for micro-piles (every 5th pile minimum)
Photographic progress documentation (minimum 5 photos per work item)
Signed daily work logs (DNOs - Diários de Obra)

earned_value_management.methodology: EVM per PMBOK 6th edition, adapted for construction
earned_value_management.planned_value_pv: Cumulative of scheduled amounts by month
earned_value_management.actual_cost_ac: Sum of invoices paid and retention held

schedule_variance_sv.interpretation: If SV > 0: ahead of schedule. If SV < 0: behind schedule.

cost_variance_cv.interpretation: If CV > 0: under budget. If CV < 0: over budget.

estimate_at_completion_eac.interpretation: Projected final cost if current cost performance continues

cost_tracking_schedule.status: Slight delay, slight overrun (monitor material costs)
2-3% delay expected due to weather; cost on target
Nearly complete; cost trending slightly high (monitor contingency burn)

cost_variance_threshold.trigger_action: If CV < -5%, trigger cost control review + change order process

schedule_variance_threshold.trigger_action: If SV < -5%, initiate schedule recovery plan + resource reallocation

budget_at_completion_variance.trigger_action: If EAC > BAC + 3%, escalate to Agente-05 for contingency review and approval

change_order_initiation.trigger: Scope change, unforeseen condition, or design change approved by engineering
change_order_initiation.request_submission: Contractor submits Change Order Request (COR) with cost impact analysis within 5 business days of event
required_documentation: Description of scope change (with before/after drawings if applicable)
Cost breakdown using SICRO rates or validated market quotes
Schedule impact (delay in days, if any)
Risk assessment (if change affects seismic resilience)
Signed approval by site engineer (for field-discovered changes)

change_order_approval_workflow.step_2_technical_review: Design/Engineering agent verifies scope and feasibility (5 business days)
change_order_approval_workflow.step_3_cost_review: Agente-05 validates cost against SICRO or market quotes, prepares cost analysis
change_order_approval_workflow.step_4_risk_review: If CO cost > 2% of base cost, risk agent (Agente-15 or Maestro) reviews seismic/geotechnical impact
change_order_approval_workflow.step_5_approval: Project Manager (delegated authority) approves if CO cost < 5% of contingency; escalate to Owner if > 5%
change_order_approval_workflow.step_6_issuance: Approved CO issued in writing; contractor notified within 10 business days

standard_co_markup.example: If material cost is 100k, contractor invoices 113k (100k + 13k markup)

time_and_material_co.approval_condition: Used only for minor COs (<500k); all T&M COs require daily DNO (diary) sign-off

change_order_budget_reserve.notification_threshold: If cumulative COs exceed 10% of base contract, notify Agente-15 (Advisory)

level_1_site_engineer.approval_authority: Petty contingency use (<100k) for field-discovered minor conditions

level_2_project_manager.approval_authority: Contingency use 100k - 500k for unforeseen subsurface or material conditions
level_2_project_manager.documentation: Formal contingency burn authorization + supporting analysis

level_3_agente_05_orcamento.approval_authority: Contingency use 500k - 2500k; updates cost baseline and payment schedule
level_3_agente_05_orcamento.documentation: Formal contingency use request + business case + impact on remaining schedule

level_4_escalation_to_owner.approval_authority: Contingency use > 2500k or cumulative CO > 10% of contract

contingency_burn_tracking.monthly_reporting: Agente-05 reports contingency balance and YTD burn rate
contingency_burn_tracking.burn_rate_target: Linear decline (no burn in design, 5-10% in procurement, 60-70% in execution)
contingency_burn_tracking.alert_condition: If burn rate exceeds linear trend by >20%, trigger cost control review

cost_baseline_freeze.baseline_lock_policy: No changes to SICRO rates or regional multipliers after baseline freeze without formal change order
cost_baseline_freeze.inflation_adjustment_policy: Monthly inflation adjustments applied per IGP-M index (transparent to contractor; no contingency impact)

monthly_payment_approval_steps.task: Contractor submits invoice + supporting docs (DCP, ASMR, photos, DNO)
Site engineer (Field Manager) verifies physical progress matches invoice claim
QA/QC team confirms test results (compaction, CBR, IRI, load tests) meet specifications
Agente-05 verifies invoice amount against contract rates and cumulative payment tracking
Agente-05 calculates earned value, cost variance, and CPI; flags if CV < -2%
Project Manager approves payment for release to finance; finance processes within 15 days
Monthly cost report issued to steering committee (EV vs. PV, CPI, SPI, EAC, contingency balance)

test_cases_and_cost_scenarios.introduction: 100+ test cases modeling cost variations across design cases, seismic risk scenarios, and regional adjustments.

scenario_1_base_case_balanced_recommende.design_philosophy: Standard seismic resilience (LI-responsive), elastic pavement, optimized geotechnical system
scenario_1_base_case_balanced_recommende.recommendation: PRIMARY BASELINE for budgeting and scheduling

scenario_2_conservative_case_maximum_res.design_philosophy: Full seismic design with redundancy; all geotechnical components oversized; highest-grade materials
scenario_2_conservative_case_maximum_res.recommendation: Consider if LI > 0.5 or if Owner risk appetite is very low; use for comparison only

scenario_3_optimized_case_value_engineer.design_philosophy: Minimal seismic adders; standard geotechnical system; conventional pavement
scenario_3_optimized_case_value_engineer.recommendation: NOT RECOMMENDED for Jericó (LI too high). Include for reference only; seismic resilience may be compromised.

scenario_4_material_cost_surge.design_philosophy: Balanced design with 15% surge in elastomeric binder and geotextile (global supply disruption)
scenario_4_material_cost_surge.risk_mitigation: Lock in material prices immediately upon design approval; consider hedging for global commodity risk
scenario_4_material_cost_surge.recommendation: Monitor material markets closely; issue procurement NTB (Notice to Bid) by month 2 of design phase

scenario_5_labor_cost_escalation.case_name: Labor Cost Escalation Scenario (+18% skilled geotechnical labor)
scenario_5_labor_cost_escalation.design_philosophy: Balanced design with 18% surge in geotechnical labor (skill scarcity exacerbates)
scenario_5_labor_cost_escalation.schedule_impact: Potential 2-month delay if labor unavailable; recommend resource augmentation
scenario_5_labor_cost_escalation.risk_mitigation: Engage drilling/pile contractors early (month 0); lock labor rates before procurement phase
scenario_5_labor_cost_escalation.recommendation: Build early team mobilization into schedule; consider subcontracting if local labor unavailable

scenario_6_geotechnical_investigation_re.case_name: Deeper Liquefaction Discovery Scenario (LI increases to 0.62)
scenario_6_geotechnical_investigation_re.design_philosophy: Balanced design escalated to Conservative with deepened piles and enhanced drainage

key_assumptions.contingency_adjustment: 20% (increased from 15%) due to new LI threshold

scenario_6_geotechnical_investigation_re.schedule_impact: 2-3 month delay for revised site investigation and engineering redesign
scenario_6_geotechnical_investigation_re.geotechnical_uncertainty: HIGH; recommend additional CPT borings (8 locations minimum) to confirm revised profile
scenario_6_geotechnical_investigation_re.recommendation: Revisit PE (Projeto Executivo) with updated geotechnical parameters; update cost baseline

scenario_7_execution_phase_productivity_.case_name: Productivity Loss Scenario (weather delays, 20% execution time inflation)
scenario_7_execution_phase_productivity_.design_philosophy: Balanced design with extended execution phase and associated overhead cost

key_assumptions.contingency_absorption: Contingency covers 360k; 180k absorbed by scheduling buffer

scenario_7_execution_phase_productivity_.risk_mitigation: Build weather buffer into schedule (June-August high-risk monsoon season); implement acceleration clauses
scenario_7_execution_phase_productivity_.recommendation: Monitor weather forecasts monthly; prepare acceleration plan if schedule variance exceeds 10%

scenario_8_seismic_design_parameter_upda.case_name: Seismic Design Parameter Update Scenario (PGA increases 0.15g → 0.18g)
scenario_8_seismic_design_parameter_upda.design_philosophy: Balanced design with 3% additional seismic adder across all components
scenario_8_seismic_design_parameter_upda.design_impact: Micro-piles require re-analysis; slope stability factor of safety reassessed
scenario_8_seismic_design_parameter_upda.schedule_impact: 2-week PE update for revised calculations; no schedule delay if absorbed in design buffer
scenario_8_seismic_design_parameter_upda.recommendation: Coordinate with Manta-03-S2 (Infrastructure agent) for revised geotechnical design; update cost baseline

scenario_9_regional_multiplier_review.case_name: Regional Multiplier Sensitivity Analysis (MG 1.08x base multiplier ± 2%)
scenario_9_regional_multiplier_review.design_philosophy: Balanced design with varying regional cost factors
scenario_9_regional_multiplier_review.recommendation: Use base case (1.08x) for budgeting; monitor supplier quotes in months 1-2 of design for refinement

scenario_10_payment_schedule_cash_flow_a.case_name: Payment Schedule Cash Flow & Financing Scenario
scenario_10_payment_schedule_cash_flow_a.design_philosophy: Balanced design with NPV and cash flow timing analysis
scenario_10_payment_schedule_cash_flow_a.recommendation: Arrange 35M credit line with 1-month interest cost hedge. Lock fixed-rate financing by month 3.

handoff_checklist_for_agente_05: Validate all SICRO rates against latest DNIT Banco de Preços (December 2024 edition)
Confirm regional multipliers (1.08x MG factor) with market surveys (obtain 3 quotes per item)
Lock material prices (elastic binder, geotextile, PVC) by end of design phase
Establish contingency reserve tracking dashboard (monthly burn rate reporting)
Set up cost baseline freeze policy (PE completion = design baseline lock)
Configure EVM tracking (PV, EV, AC, CPI, SPI) in project management tool
Prepare change order templates and authorization workflow documentation
Coordinate with Finance for payment processing (15-day SLA)
Schedule monthly cost reviews (1st Tuesday of each month)
Prepare contingency release criteria documentation for Owner approval
risk_factors_requiring_agente_05_monitor: Material supply chain for elastomeric binder (global commodity risk)
Geotechnical labor availability (skill scarcity in MG region)
Seismic design parameter updates (risk of PGA revision)
Weather impact on execution schedule (June-August monsoon risk)
Regional inflation (IGP-M indexing may exceed 3% quarterly)
Liquefaction investigation findings (potential for deeper piles requirement)
escalation_triggers: If CPI < 0.98 (cost overrun > 2%), escalate to Agente-15 (Advisory)
If SPI < 0.95 (schedule slip > 5%), escalate to Maestro (router) for resource review
If contingency burn exceeds 50% before month 16, trigger contingency release review
If cumulative COs exceed 10% of base contract, escalate to Owner
If liquefaction investigation reveals LI > 0.55, escalate for geotechnical redesign
references_and_documents: SICRO December 2024 Edition (DNIT Banco de Preços)
NBR 15953 - Seismic Design for Roadways and Structures
NBR 7187 - Steel and Concrete Bridges (for any bridge retrofits)
